_about: GSPro recipe. Boots GSPro through its launcher, opens the Square connector's Visual Data window if GSPconnect is in use, and adds a Driving Range shortcut that clicks through to the practice range. Tested with GSPro installed in the default C:\GSProV1 folder.
title: Golf Simulator
subtitle: Choose a simulator to start

obs._note: OBS shows a Safe Mode prompt after it was force-closed; deleting its crash markers prevents that, and the click below handles it if it appears anyway.
obs.label: Clearing OBS crash flag

obs._note: Add --collection "Your Scenes" and/or --profile "Your Profile" to pick what OBS opens with.
obs.label: Starting OBS

obs._note: 4455 is OBS's WebSocket server (Tools > WebSocket Server Settings). If it's turned off this just times out and the boot carries on.
obs.label: Waiting for OBS

gsproAfterLaunch._note: Only for Square launch monitors connected through GSPconnect; harmlessly skipped otherwise.
gsproAfterLaunch.label: Opening Square visual data

sims.name: GSPro
sims.subtitle: Courses, practice range and online play

steps._note: GSPLauncher starts GSPro by itself when there's no update, so this is skipped as soon as GSPro is running.
steps.label: Checking for updates, then launching GSPro

steps._note: Only when GSPro was started with its screen selector; skipped once the game window (UnityWndClass) is up.
steps.label: Confirming screen settings

steps._note: GSPro is a Unity game, so its menu is read with OCR.
steps.label: Opening Practice

steps._note: The practice screen's heading also says PRACTICE RANGE, so match the tile's own caption.
steps.label: Loading the driving range
